products: All-in-one AI-powered talent platform combining ATS, CRM, scheduling, and analytics for recruiting teams. Customers include Notion, Linear, Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, and Ramp. Expanding beyond talent acquisition into adjacent products.
fiscal_outlook: Raised $50M Series D in July 2025 (Alkeon / Lachy Groom; Forge cites ~$492M post-money). Reported ~135% ARR growth and customer base roughly 1,300→2,700 around that raise; burn multiple cited under 1x. Private; remote-first (~220 employees across 20+ countries per Series D coverage).
hiring_trends: Americas Engineering actively hiring Engineering Managers, Staff/Senior Product Engineers, and Design Engineers; EMEA/Canada mirrors. Messaging emphasizes doubling eng, high ownership, TypeScript/React/Node/Postgres, AI-assisted developer tooling.
similar_role_hires: Senior Product Engineer - Americas and Staff Product Engineer - Americas open on Ashby’s own ATS with published US bands ($178k–$250k senior; higher for staff). Design Engineer tracks also open.
hiring_profile: Credible always-on product eng hiring on company ATS with deep JDs, published geo bands, and a structured no-leetcode process. Low ghost-job risk given growth narrative and callback activity; seniority bar is high (90%+ senior+).
